industry.why: Neutral, carried, split: Kofler (Jefferies, 21 and 26-Nov) finds 2028 free-cash-flow yields of 7 to 10% at the big miners and calls steel 'a decent place to be into next year', LaFemina (21-Nov) says the mining recovery needs the end of Fed tightening and 'may take time', and no source spoke to chemicals. Relative strength D (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; C prior). Base chemicals, Steel, Cement and Construction carry D; Fragrances, Specialty chemicals and Forestry stay C. No change.

sector.why: Underweight, carried: construction postponed under a contested rate path; no source spoke to contractors; relative strength D (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; C prior). No Pool name. Counter-case: rate-sensitive groups are the most oversold and where a relief rally starts; back to C if the Fed path is marked down.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to Poland; Goldman's emerging markets team (24-Nov) is constructive on emerging markets as a group with rates near a peak, which is general, not Polish. Fourteen Pool stocks are Polish, eight of them banks, so this is still the country row most likely to move. Relative strength is not graded by country.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
